text:
Maya Rivera: hey team :wave: I'm Maya — started today on Product/Design. Quick access issues: I can't open the Redwood Inference Figma org (getting a 403) and I also don't have access to the product roadmap Notion or the research drive. Who should I ping to get added?

Lena (DesignOps): welcome Maya! :tada: usually we add new designers to the 'Product Designers' Okta group. Ben, can you confirm Maya is in that group?

Ben - IT: I provisioned the account earlier today. Figma invites sometimes land in spam — search for an email from `noreply@figma.com`. If you're still blocked, reply here and I'll trigger a manual invite. Quick steps if you want to try: `Okta -> Applications -> Figma -> Assign -> search 'Maya Rivera'`. Internal fallback: `invites send --user maya@redwood.com --app figma`.

Maya Rivera: checked spam and promotions, nothing so far. Notion invite is also missing.

Kyle Tran: hi Maya — I'll add you to the Product roadmap Notion page and the Model Serving epic board. Which initiatives are you joining? I'll grant edit/view accordingly. Roadmap link for reference: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Product-Roadmap-xxxx

Maya Rivera: I'm on the Model Serving team with Jess — thanks!

Jess Alvarez: welcome! For research assets: Notion -> Research (Playbooks -> Methods) has our process and templates. Drive folder is at drive.google.com/drive/folders/RESEARCH_ARCHIVE (request access if you need copies). Our lightweight research process: PM + Designer pair, create a Notion brief, run ~5 quick usability sessions, synth + share highlights in ops channel. Ping me and I'll hand over interview transcripts from recent model tuning sessions.

Lena (DesignOps): I just added you to the Figma 'Product Designers' team; you should have access within ~5 minutes. If you still see 403, paste an error screenshot here and I'll escalate.

Maya Rivera: I can open Figma now — thanks so much! :relieved: Notion invite still pending though.

Ben - IT: resent the Notion invite a moment ago. Check promotions and the email associated with your work account. If it still doesn't show, DM me your email and I'll add you manually.

Kyle Tran: done — added you to the roadmap page and to the 'Model Serving' epic board. Also added you to the slack channel `#model-serving` so you get docs and planning threads. :rocket:

Maya Rivera: amazing, thanks! One more Q: who runs the design critique cadence? I'd like to jump in.

Jess Alvarez: critiques are Thursdays 10am PT. I'll send a calendar invite and add you to the recurring event and the crit notes Notion page. See you there.

DesignBot: Automated: Added Maya Rivera to group 'Product Designers'. Welcome package (onboarding checklist, Figma templates, research playbook) sent to your email.
